name: Summit AZ - Context - Photos and Brand Assets
body:
> Log · Summit Az · 2026-08-14

# Summary
Image folders for Summit AZ. Not summarized per image.

# Folders
- `Photos\`: 6 job photos (WebP, original IMG names such as IMG_2377, IMG_3049, IMG_3267).
- `summit-plumbing-pros-photos-2026-08-14\`: 32 numbered job photos (WebP) received 2026-08-14, useful for the `[FIRST-HAND DETAIL]` placeholders in blog clusters and for GBP posts.
- `badges\`: two transparent PNG versions of a "Summit 100 Trusted Plumber" badge (v1, v2).
- Blog banners and inline images live in `blogs\banners\` and `blogs\images\` (see [Summit AZ - Blogs Folder Overview](lib:brain-summit-az-blogs-folder-overview)).
- `perf-tracker\shots\` and `blog-restyle-pilot-2026-09-15\` hold report and before/after screenshots.
